responsibility: Provides the x86 F16C intrinsic header for half-precision and single-precision conversion operations. It enables the f16c feature as needed and defines wrappers for scalar and packed float-to-half and half-to-float conversions, including the immediate-controlled rounding forms, translating the standard intrinsic API onto GCC’s x86 conversion builtins for 128-bit and 256-bit vectors.
